about: Boilerplate masking rules shared by pipeline/clean.py and web/src/lib/clean.ts. Matched case-insensitively, ASCII \b \w \d semantics, no inline flags, no lookbehind. 'line' patterns are tested against each trimmed line and mask the whole line; 'inline' patterns mask only the matched span. Keep Subject/To/Attendees/When/Date lines: they carry meeting content.

line.name: google calendar email footer
line.pattern: ^(view all guest info|invitation from google calendar|reply for \S+.*|yes\s+no\s+maybe(\s+more options)?|you are receiving this (email|courtesy email|notification)\b.*|forwarding this invitation could allow\b.*|learn more about google calendar\b.*)$

line.name: webex
line.pattern: ^(join from the meeting link|join by meeting number|meeting (number|password)\b.*|when it's time, join the webex meeting here\.?|-*\s*do not delete or change any of the following text\.?\s*-*)$

line.name: new teams
line.pattern: ^(microsoft teams( need help\?)?|join the meeting now|need help\?)$

line.name: meeting options
line.pattern: ^(.*[|\u2013\u2014-]\s*)?learn more\s*\|\s*meeting options$|^learn more about meeting options$

line.name: zoom
line.pattern: ^(join zoom( meeting)?|one[- ]tap mobile|dial by your location)\b.*$

line.name: zoom invitation line
line.pattern: ^.+ is inviting you to a scheduled( zoom)? meeting\.?$

line.name: google meet
line.pattern: ^(join with google meet|google meet( joining info)?)\b.*$

line.name: join label
line.pattern: ^join( online| video| zoom| webex| teams)?( meeting)?:.*$
